gloss_en: THE Tzaddik (ha-tzaddik) — the singular true tzaddik of the generation, the 'head' (rosh) of the Jewish people from whom all the generations are drawn; the Moses-figure/leader archetype to whom one travels (e.g., for Rosh Hashanah) and whose passing is mourned; not tzaddikim in general nor the sefirah Yesod as such
